Support

Source: SUPPORT.md

dragonfarm is free and open source (MIT), looked after by one person, as time allows. There is no paid support and no service-level promise.

Getting help

  • Something broke. Open an issue with the output of dragon_check(), what you did, and what happened. For a training run, the run’s log.txt helps most.
  • A security problem. Not in a public issue: see SECURITY.md.
  • A question or an idea. An issue is fine; the feature form asks what you are trying to do, which matters more than how.

Which versions

Only the latest release on CRAN and the main branch on GitHub are looked after. Fixes go into the next release; older releases are not patched, and there are no long-term-support releases.

For a team or a company

You can use, change and ship dragonfarm under the MIT licence, including inside a validated system. Validation is yours to do: the package gives you a qualification report, an append-only record, and the measurements behind its claims, but nobody checks your deployment for you. If you need guaranteed answers, plan for your own people to own it.
